text: 你们中持步枪的人开始向外星生物射击。其中一只抓起扭曲的银色装置指向你，一道光束击中你躲藏的岩石！
冰晶在你眼前形成，覆盖岩石表面。碎片在一声巨响中崩裂。
你击中那只外星生物的腹部，它倒了下去。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 479
text: Each of you with a rifle starts firing at the alien creatures. One of them grabs a twisted silvery device and points it at you. A beam strikes the rock you crouch behind!
Ice crystals form before your eyes, coating the surface of the rock. Fragments shatter off with a loud crack.
You hit that alien in its midriff, and it falls.
